newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon May construction down on annual basis.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon May construction down on annual basis.

text.p: Construction activity picked up slightly in May on a monthly basis as cement deliveries increased while the area of approved construction permits declined heavily on a yearly basis, the Bank of Lebanon said on Friday.

"The area of construction permits approved by the Association of Engineers in Beirut and Tripoli declined by 34.1 percent during May 1997, relative to May 1996," the bank said in its late monthly bulletin.
In its previous bulletin, the bank said construction's downward trend was a result of market imbalance and housing loan scarcity.
May cement deliveries increased by 4.2 percent on an annual basis, rising to 360,000 tonnes from 252,000 tonnes a month earlier.
Real estate fees collected totalled 21.8 billion Lebanese pounds, for an annual rise of 10.8 percent, the bank said.
